PDF Single-Pass GPU Solid Voxelization for Real-Time Applications
Each application illustrates the versatility of our real-time solid voxelization and improves previous work in some aspects. We were motivated by two goals: fast solid voxelization based on slicemaps (explained in Section 4) and the derivation of normal information. Consequently, the method's description is divided into two parts.
